question: Should this PR wait for conflict-resolved exact-head Android validation and real Sharesheet proof, or may a maintainer explicitly override that proof gate?
rationale: The implementation now appears correct from source and focused tests, but the repaired behavior has neither completed its Android build lane nor run through the real provider, activity, and composer lifecycle on the final head.

options.title: Require exact-head proof
options.body: Resolve conflicts, complete Android build/tests, and demonstrate cold, warm, repeated, image, preserved-draft, and explicit-send flows on an emulator or physical device.

options.title: Override the proof gate
options.body: Explicitly accept source and automated coverage while owning the remaining device-specific and final-merge uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Require exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts, complete Android build/tests, and demonstrate cold, warm, repeated, image, preserved-draft, and explicit-send flows on an emulator or physical device.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and authored the repaired head, so he is the clearest available owner for a proof override decision.
